$comment: Operative source of truth for FR-5 and FR-6 (D3). The statutory text appears in exactly one place — here. It is not duplicated in code, in prompts, or in prose. Correcting this file corrects the system. Design rationale in docs/config/warning-statement.md.
appliesTo: All alcoholic beverages — beer, wine, distilled spirits
retrievedFrom: Cornell LII mirror of the CFR
verificationNote: eCFR blocked automated retrieval. Confirm against https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-27/chapter-I/subchapter-A/part-16/subpart-C/section-16.21 in a browser, then set verificationStatus to CONFIRMED. A single wrong word here silently invalidates every warning-statement verdict (M0, Q1a).

segments.label: Surgeon General / pregnancy
segments.text: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects.

segments.label: Impairment / health problems
segments.text: (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause health problems.

advisoryChecks.text: The rest of the warning is NOT in bold type
advisoryChecks.note: Raised by no stakeholder. The regulation constrains over-emphasis as well as under-emphasis.

advisoryChecks.text: Type size meets the minimum for this container size (up to 237 mL: 1 mm; over 237 mL to 3 L: 2 mm; over 3 L: 3 mm)
advisoryChecks.note: Depends on net contents, so it cannot be evaluated from artwork alone.

advisoryChecks.text: The warning is separate and apart from other label information
Readily legible, on a contrasting background, characters not compressed
